only_numerical_change: gnss_correlation_s: 60 -> 1000; one scalar physical time constant shared by N/E/D
model: stationary first-order Gauss-Markov slow component plus independent white noise; unchanged existing ppid_noise RNG and recurrence
assumptions: Representative engineering condition for control/allocation simulation, not a calibrated NEO V2 receiver. Horizontal sigma retains the project CEP interpretation; vertical sigma, white components and velocity sigma retain engineering assumptions. ULog supports update/measurement-quality checks, not identification of slow sigma or correlation time.
reference_scope: MathWorks documents first-order GM with dimensionless DecayFactor, not a fixed physical 1000s default. BYU textbook author code uses gps_k=1/1100 s^-1; this project selects 1000s and retains its own sigma values.
